note: Route-graph ratchet baseline (no-new-rot ratchet). Each entry is the CURRENT reachable-first-party-module-count ceiling for a LOCKED FIXED_ROUTES route (the primary dev-perf 'first-party graph pressure' metric from scripts/route-graph.mjs). The gate fails when a tracked route's count grows BEYOND its ceiling and when the committed baseline raises any ceiling vs the base branch WITHOUT a matching absorb record. Counts are captured WITH the companion extension repos cloned pinned (exactly as CI does via clone-extensions) so they reproduce in CI. Regenerate with `node scripts/audit/route-graph-ratchet.mjs --write-baseline` after cloning the extensions — a ceiling should only ever be LOWERED as barrel imports are narrowed, and is never raised SILENTLY. A sanctioned raise must be ANNOTATED: a sibling `absorbs` record `route -> { from, to, reason, pr }` whose from/to exactly match the raise vs the base branch (from = the base ceiling, to = the new committed ceiling, reason = why the growth is accepted, pr = the PR carrying the absorbed change). The gate validates records strictly (malformed/stale/orphan records fail closed; a carried-forward record may not be deleted while its raised ceiling is kept) and prints a LOUD NOTICE line for every absorbed raise. The tracked route set is route-graph.mjs FIXED_ROUTES; change it there, then regenerate.

/api/a2a.reason: cinatra#2290 — the selective required-lock bump advances @cinatra-ai/openai-connector 255a44b2 -> d733250a to cure F9 (cinatra-ai/openai-connector#75: an unreachable connection service rolled the whole OpenAI key save back and reported failure, so a valid key could not be saved from the setup form; the pin is the only thing that carries that fix to instances). That range adds exactly ONE first-party module, extensions/cinatra-ai/openai-connector/src/partial-save-outcome.ts (confirmed with git diff --diff-filter=A between the two shas; the only other addition is a workflow YAML), statically reachable from all five locked routes through the generated extension map: +1 module on each. It is irreducible, not an un-narrowed barrel — it is new companion source in a repo this PR does not own, and scripts/route-graph.mjs follows dynamic import(), so a lazy import would move runtime cost while pretending the graph shrank. The +1 is attributed, not assumed: diffing analyzeRoute().byOwner per owner package between the base pin set and this head shows extensions/cinatra-ai/openai-connector as the ONLY owner that grows, +1 on every route and no other owner moving anywhere. Measured on this PR head with the companion extension repos cloned pinned exactly as CI does (111/111, missingCount 0); the base pin set reproduced the committed ceilings exactly, which is what makes the attribution trustworthy. The #2242 records this raise supersedes are retired by --write-baseline per the gate's retire-on-re-raise rule; from = main's committed ceiling at branch time, to = that ceiling + the irreducible +1 this record absorbs.
